text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while walking through the academy...

text_block_list.name: Turbo's Friend
text_block_list.text: "Hey, hey! Wanna do an impromptu race right now? Turbo's been racing a lot lately, so teach me stuff!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: !! I'll do it, I want to do it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: All right, time to run... yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Turbo's Friend
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Turbo?! The track isn't that way!
Wait, change into your gym clothes—

text_block_list.name: Turbo's Friend
text_block_list.text:
...Turbo, let's save the impromptu race for next time!
Want to go grab some sweets together today instead?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No no way! Turbo's gonna run...!
I can ruuuuun...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Twin Turbo's body can't keep up with her spirit.
Taking her fatigue into account, let's reconsider her upcoming race schedule.
